course_outline_concepts: DPO (Rafailov 2023): closed-form derivation r*(x,y) = beta log pi*(y|x)/pi_ref(y|x) + beta log Z(x); implicit reward; beta schedule; Llama 3 hyperparameters
IPO (Azar 2023): identity link; mean-squared loss bounded by 1/(2 tau); failure mode of DPO on deterministic preferences
KTO (Ethayarajh 2024): prospect-theory value function; unary desirable/undesirable labels; lambda_D / lambda_U class-balance weights
SimPO (Meng 2024): reference-free average-log-prob reward; length-normalized implicit reward; target reward margin gamma
ORPO (Hong 2024): joint SFT + odds-ratio loss; single-stage alignment; lambda balancing
RPO / Iterative-RPO (Pang 2024): DPO + NLL on chosen; iterative sample-label-train loop
Decision framework: which variant by data shape / compute / target; when to fall back to PPO or GRPO

sources.what_to_extract: KL-constrained reward-max objective; optimal policy pi*(y|x) = (1/Z(x)) pi_ref(y|x) exp(r(x,y)/beta); inversion r(x,y) = beta log pi/pi_ref + beta log Z(x); Z(x) cancellation in Bradley-Terry differences; DPO loss Eq 7; implicit reward r_hat; gradient form with sigma automatic weighting; hyperparameters (beta 0.1, LR 5e-7).
PsiPO family; Psi = identity recovers IPO, Psi = logit recovers DPO; DPO's unboundedness on deterministic preferences; IPO squared loss (h - 1/(2 tau))^2; h as log-ratio difference; tau vs beta.

Prospect-theory HALO family; unary desirable/undesirable labels; reference point z_0 = KL; value function v(x,y) with lambda_D on gains / lambda_U on losses; KTO loss as expectation of (lambda - v); class-balance recipe lambda_D / lambda_U = N_U / N_D.
Reference-free reward r(x,y) = (beta/|y|) sum log pi(y_t | x, y_<t); SimPO loss with target margin gamma; reference-free memory savings ~2x throughput; length-bias correction; beta ~2-2.5 (20x DPO).

Odds definition odds(y|x) = pi/(1-pi); odds-ratio loss L_OR = -log sigma(log OR); total ORPO loss L_SFT + lambda L_OR; lambda 0.1-0.25; single-stage from base model; why reference-free works (SFT anchors chosen side).
DPO + alpha NLL(chosen); alpha = 1.0; iterative sample-label-train with ground-truth verifier; chosen-logprob anchoring; round-over-round accuracy compounding on GSM8K / MATH.
When-to-use-which decision guidance; loss_type parameter exposing all variants; chosen-logprob collapse as central failure mode; TRL DPOTrainer as unified surface.

DPOLoss module with beta, label_smoothing, ipo flags; pi_logratios - ref_logratios as implicit margin; concatenated_forward memory trick; NLL mixing for chosen-logprob stabilization; MoE aux-loss preservation; chosen_rewards / rejected_rewards as diagnostic.

Online DPO pattern: 2x prompts -> generate, rank by judge, apply DPO on fresh pairs; KL as drift canary; rewards/accuracies (margin > 0); loss_type switch sigmoid vs ipo. Used here as contrast: offline family vs its online cousin.
Llama 3 DPO hparams: LR 1e-5, beta 0.1, NLL coeff 0.2 on chosen; 6 iterative rounds of SFT -> Rejection Sampling -> DPO; most-recent-batch preference data; single epoch per round.
161K human-preference dialogues; helpful/harmless subsets; MIT license; noise floor ~70-75% human agreement; data shape that DPO and variants consume.
GPT-4 judge scored responses; multi-aspect rubric; binarized pairwise subset as DPO-ready; judge bias propagation; used by Zephyr / Tulu as canonical synthetic DPO data.
